subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Target Data Breach
description: A 60-second lesson on The Target Data Breach.

hook.text: During the 2013 holiday season, hackers stole 40 million credit card numbers from Target stores.

buildup.text: Attackers first hacked an HVAC contractor that had remote access to Target's network.

discovery.text: Malware on point-of-sale terminals captured card data as customers swiped during checkout.

twist.text: Target's security system flagged the intrusion, but the alerts were ignored by the team.

climax.text: The breach cost Target $300 million and its CEO resigned. The HVAC vendor was the weak link.

punchline.text: The hackers got in through the air conditioning company.

quiz.question: How did hackers initially access Target's network?
options: Through a phishing email to Target employees
